verdict_reason: The organisation-header default and the seeding helper are correct, but the helper's name hides delete-and-replace, its comments describe callers, the org id is duplicated in NotificationIT, and one overload is unreachable.

todos.issue: ensureTraderNotification (lines 161, 166) deletes any notification already stored under the reference and saves a fresh DRAFT one. 'ensure' predicts a no-op when one exists; the name hides the delete-and-replace and the DRAFT status it forces.
todos.fix: Must: the helper's name says it replaces whatever is stored under the reference with a new draft owned by the organisation. One way: rename to replaceWithDraftNotification(repository, referenceNumber) / seedDraftNotificationOwnedBy, and update DocumentControllerIT:181 and EcsLoggingIT:43.

todos.issue: Comments describe callers and other modules, not the lines below: the Javadoc on ensureTraderNotification (157-160) explains that 'document routes can enforce requireTraderAccess' (DocumentController/NotificationService), and the class Javadoc (56-57) says 'tests currently pass "NoAuth"'. Javadoc on an internal test helper is also outside the contract-only rule, and the class Javadoc's webClient paragraph (54-58) no longer states that the client also sends the Trade-Imports-Organisation-Id header.
todos.fix: Must: no comment in IntegrationBase describes its callers or production code; the helper's name carries its meaning. One way: delete the Javadoc at 157-160, drop the 'tests currently pass NoAuth' sentence, and either delete the webClient paragraph of the class Javadoc or make it state both default headers.

todos.issue: The default trader organisation '5900002' has two homes in the IT hierarchy: DEFAULT_TRADER_ORG_ID here (line 65) and NotificationIT.ORG_ID (NotificationIT.java:63), a subclass that then asserts created.getOrganisationId() equals its own copy (NotificationIT:133, 1996) and passes it to webClient("NoAuth", ORG_ID). Change one and the other silently disagrees.
todos.fix: Must: the IT bases own the default organisation id once, and NotificationIT uses the inherited constant. One way: delete NotificationIT.ORG_ID and reference DEFAULT_TRADER_ORG_ID (keep OTHER_ORG_ID local or promote it beside the default).

todos.issue: The three-argument ensureTraderNotification(repository, referenceNumber, organisationId) overload (166-177) has no caller outside the two-argument overload: DocumentControllerIT:181 and EcsLoggingIT:43 both use the default organisation, and no test seeds a notification for another organisation through it.
todos.fix: Must: the helper offers only what a test reaches. One way: fold the two overloads into one method using DEFAULT_TRADER_ORG_ID, or add the cross-organisation document test that needs the organisation parameter (e.g. a document route returning 404 for another organisation's notification).

todos.issue: The five new uk.gov.defra imports (lines 34-38) are inserted in the middle of the org.springframework block, between org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource and org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient, breaking the file's lexicographic import order.
todos.fix: Must: imports are in the file's sorted order. One way: move the uk.gov.defra imports after the org.testcontainers imports.
